items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: You work for Radford. Right. ... The last thing I saw, we stole this car.

ctx.x: You work for Radford. Right. Yeah, he's retired now. Mm-hmm.
Radford went to, went to, last I heard of him went to Germany or somewhere, didn't he? He's back now. He's back?
I hate getting an apartment and everything.
